episode_abort_and_recovery.stop: The episode loop records the fault and does not execute another unverified target.
episode_abort_and_recovery.recovery: handle_episode_fault logs the fault, then rollback_to_baseline writes high_level_policy g1_rate only after G1_RATE k=6 and the frozen MAPPO-V2 hash both verify.
episode_abort_and_recovery.rollback_failure: Raise RollbackError. Do not select any policy other than the explicit g1_rate rollback.

model_load_failure.missing_checkpoint: file_sha256 raises CheckpointError and appends a checkpoint_rejected log. Model weights are not replaced.
model_load_failure.hash_mismatch: verify_startup_hashes raises CheckpointError before FormalPlanner loads the actor or scheme C.
model_load_failure.missing_or_illegal_policy: read_policy raises PolicyError. It does not default to scheme_c.

illegal_assignment.behavior: An illegal candidate or a TaskOption that is no longer legal stops the new decision. The episode does not keep that target.

nonfinite_output.behavior: NaN or Inf scores are rejected. Non-finite served bits, SINR, or rate stop the episode and follow the same recovery rule.

rollback.failure: Stop with RollbackError and do not switch to another strategy.

observed_evidence.note: Phase-6I-AD measurements on one Windows process. They are not deployment limits.
